beats.title: A Knife in the Dark, Foiled

beats.statement: The court of the Mad King assembles, and the Herald opens the show.
The Mad King decrees that the Friday bottle and the throne go to the last contestant standing. The Herald proclaims it.
The Jester speaks a prophecy about who will win the throne, and Sanna hears it.
Sanna and Öhman swear an alliance to stand together.
The Royal Adviser poisons a goblet and serves it to Liisa. Liisa drinks it and dies. This is the first blood of the contest.
The Mad King sees Öhman as a threat to the throne and banishes them from the realm.
Sanna renounces the crown, takes the Grey Cloak and leaves the contest for the Wall.

announcements.headline: Sanna is OUT
announcements.cause: forfeited by taking the Grey Cloak

beats.statement: Kalle meets Matti in a trial by combat and wins. Matti is killed.

announcements.headline: Matti is OUT
announcements.cause: slain by Kalle in Trial by Combat

beats.statement: Jääskeläinen wounds Kalle in a fight. Kalle survives, but is hurt.
The Iron Vault calls in Kalle's debt. Kalle cannot pay and is exiled from the realm.

announcements.headline: Kalle is OUT
announcements.cause: exiled by the Iron Vault for an unpaid debt

beats.statement: The Red Priestess brings Liisa back from the dead. Liisa is alive again and back in the contest.

announcements.headline: Liisa RETURNS
announcements.cause: raised from the dead by the Red Priestess and back in the contest

beats.statement: Pekka narrowly escapes a deadly accident and stays in the contest.
Pekka renounces the crown, takes the Grey Cloak and leaves the contest for the Wall.

announcements.headline: Pekka is OUT
announcements.cause: forfeited by taking the Grey Cloak

beats.statement: Liisa faces the dragon alone. The dragon slays Liisa. The dragon survives.
The Mad King pardons Jääskeläinen for an offence against the crown, for now.
Aino and Jääskeläinen swear an alliance to stand together.
Jääskeläinen tries to stab their ally Aino in the back, but fails. Aino survives, and the alliance between them is broken.
Aino and Jääskeläinen swear an alliance to stand together.
Jääskeläinen and Aino, the last two contestants, fight the final duel. Aino is killed.

announcements.headline: Aino is OUT
announcements.cause: defeated by Jääskeläinen in the Last Duel

beats.statement: Jääskeläinen is crowned the new monarch of the Bottle Throne by the Mad King.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Hear ye! The bottle awaits a worthy hand.

lines.speaker: old_king
lines.text: I am the Mad King, and this throne is still warm.

lines.speaker: npc_herald
lines.text: Let the peasants step forward!

lines.speaker: old_king
lines.text: New rules: no sulking, no mercy, no refunds.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nobody dares to ask what the old rules were.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The candles gutter. The seer's eyes roll back.

lines.speaker: npc_jester
lines.text: One who bears the sign of the Boar. One who faces a Bard at the last.

lines.speaker: p07
lines.text: Clearly it means me.

lines.speaker: p04
lines.text: Is it always like this around here?

lines.speaker: p08
lines.text: My sword is yours, Sanna.

lines.speaker: p07
lines.text: And mine is... somewhere near yours.

lines.speaker: p02
lines.text: And this is why I never sit near the door.

lines.speaker: npc_adviser
lines.text: A toast to you, Liisa!

lines.speaker: p04
lines.text: How kind! It tastes of almonds.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The goblet rolls across the table.

lines.speaker: old_king
lines.text: Out of my sight, Öhman!

lines.speaker: p08
lines.text: I was only asking about the bottle.

lines.speaker: p05
lines.text: And this is why I never sit near the door.

lines.speaker: p07
lines.text: On second thought, the cold sounds nice.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And so Sanna leaves the game for good.

lines.speaker: p05
lines.text: Have at thee!

lines.speaker: p03
lines.text: Have at thee harder!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Matti falls, and is out of the contest.

lines.speaker: p02
lines.text: Take that!

lines.speaker: p03
lines.text: Ow! That is my good arm!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Iron Vault sends its regards, and its bill.

lines.speaker: p03
lines.text: Can I pay in compliments?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Kalle is escorted to the harbor. One way.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The ghost of Matti has come to watch.

lines.speaker: p05
lines.text: Now we are even.

lines.speaker: p04
lines.text: Death could not hold me!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Liisa walks again. Several people faint.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A falling gargoyle misses Pekka by a hair.

lines.speaker: p06
lines.text: I meant to do that!

lines.speaker: p06
lines.text: On second thought, the cold sounds nice.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And so Pekka leaves the game for good.

lines.speaker: p04
lines.text: That is rather more dragon than I expected.

lines.speaker: p04
lines.text: I may have underestimated the teeth.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Liisa falls, and is out of the contest.

captions.text: The dragon slays Liisa. The dragon survives.

lines.speaker: old_king
lines.text: Jääskeläinen, I pardon you. For now.

lines.speaker: p02
lines.text: Your Majesty is too kind.

lines.speaker: p01
lines.text: Together we rise, Jääskeläinen.

lines.speaker: p02
lines.text: Together. Until it is inconvenient.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They shake on it. Both count their fingers after.

lines.speaker: p02
lines.text: Goodnight, sweet ally.

lines.speaker: p01
lines.text: Not tonight, traitor!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The blade bounces off a lucky belt buckle.

lines.speaker: p02
lines.text: My sword is yours, Aino.

lines.speaker: p01
lines.text: And mine is... somewhere near yours.

lines.speaker: p02
lines.text: For the bottle!

lines.speaker: p01
lines.text: For... also the bottle!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Aino falls, and is out of the contest.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And so the prophecy is fulfilled.

lines.speaker: p02
lines.text: The bottle is mine!

lines.speaker: old_king
lines.text: Take good care of it.

chronicle.epilogue: When the dust settled, Jääskeläinen the Schemer sat upon the Bottle Throne. 8 rivals fell, fled or were sent away along the way. The old crown passed on, the prophecy came true, and the bottle was finally opened. Long may Jääskeläinen reign, at least until next Friday.
chronicle.cover_title: The Bottle Throne: A Clash of Corks
chronicle.blurb: 8 peasants. One bottle. Alliances, betrayals and a very suspicious goat. Who will be crowned when the curtain falls?
